body:
Delivered the complete independent ACVC paired-exposure B01 scientific review for the fixed task at d17e4f4e5f2710c9af157ae42bde98617a600cc0:

https://github.com/CartmanFatass/My-paper-code/blob/68fed46f448312827f38b4b4f9bade36e2aedc35/docs/research/candidates/acvc/pro_packets/20260914_cluster_paired_exposure_b01_scientific_review/archive/RESPONSE.md

The review identifies no material result-invalidating or workload-reporting defect. It preserves the four separate UP endpoint readings, designated paired DECREASE, covariance, adverse tails, absolute attained-control improvements, and one-programme/two-correlated-snapshot claim ceiling. It favors consolidating the Portfolio development/retention report over an automatic further exposure run, while giving the strongest case for a new prospective fixed-recipe population study and clarifying that a single additional B can still change development judgment without settling population uncertainty. No empirical repair or successor invocation is selected.

The response retains the task's exact per-path commits: ae1ec3632fe59312850e912a7e32890295da4425 for scientific records, 8fd41b61f3c8d3c70057492a18e619ef0faeda78 for inspected source, and 5a6533cb693b4f9d1e6bdbd411ce087ef4b1dacf for methods. Readback and commit comparison confirm that delivery commit 68fed46f448312827f38b4b4f9bade36e2aedc35 adds only the specified response file. No source, card, previous response, main, scientific state, priorities or slots were changed; no code execution, experiment or outcome reanalysis occurred. DM responds and owns ordinary science; Portfolio retains final direction lifecycle.
